# Driver: argument parsing, help text, error reporting, and the subcommands.
# The version header is generated by the top-level CMakeLists
# (cmake/version.h.in) and reaches this target through minc_target_configure().
minc_add_library(minc_driver
  SOURCES
    cli.cc
    command_spec.cc
    response_file.cc
    diagnostic_options.cc
    help_render.cc
    help_text.cc
    suggest.cc
    error_report.cc
    input_source.cc
    lex_command.cc
    parse_command.cc
    pp_command.cc
    resolve_command.cc
    check_command.cc
    frontend.cc
    stage_report.cc
    ir_command.cc
    build_command.cc
    builtins_command.cc
  DEPS minc_support minc_builtins minc_lex minc_lex_report minc_syntax minc_parse_report minc_pp
       minc_pp_report minc_pp_parse minc_ast minc_resolve minc_resolve_report
       minc_sema minc_sema_report minc_ir minc_ir_report minc_backend
       minc_backend_report minc_fs
)

minc_add_executable(mincc SOURCES main.cc DEPS minc_driver)
